issues.problem: Runtime test SSIM uses valid (unpadded) convolution; official render.py uses 3DGS utils.loss_utils.ssim (same padding). Training loss in the plugin is correctly same-padded, but reported test SSIM is not protocol-identical to the paper's metric.
issues.evidence: losses.py:15-18 conv2d(groups=3) with no padding vs official _ssim padding=window_size//2
issues.fix: State in the analysis that SSIM is not exactly comparable to Table 1 (0.713) or evaluate with a same-padded SSIM; PSNR/LPIPS unaffected.

issues.problem: Schedule is hard-coded to total_steps=10000 and the guard only checks renderer counter == runtime step; it does not check runtime --steps == total_steps, so a run with other --steps silently gets a truncated/clamped schedule (smoke runs at 2000 steps reach r=0.04 only).
issues.evidence: before_backward compares drop['step'] to step only; min(self.step,total_steps) clamps silently
issues.fix: Optionally have density.before_backward/ bench assert steps == total_steps for paper runs (bench_request already uses 10000).

issues.problem: Any grad-enabled render (visualisation, custom eval) applies dropout and advances the counter; the density sync check catches this only inside training.
issues.fix: Acceptable for the native runtime (measure is @torch.no_grad); document.

issues.problem: Visibility radii come from gsplat projection: opacity-aware radius (extend=min(3.33, sqrt(2 ln(o/(1/255))))) and cull of o<1/255, near plane 0.01 vs Inria radius from covariance only (3 sigma, near 0.2). Dropped Gaussians are correctly kept in the denominator with zero gradient (verified in probe), but low-opacity Gaussians (after resets to 0.01) get smaller radii and edge Gaussians may be counted slightly less than in the official code. Applies equally to dropgaussian and nodrop.
issues.fix: None required; keep as documented gap.

issues.problem: Known unmatched details: views sampled with replacement vs official shuffled stack; Adam step before density (official densifies first); SH degree increments one step later; gsplat alpha clamp 0.999 vs Inria 0.99 (matters slightly more under 1/(1-r) boosted opacities >1); own COLMAP MVS init instead of authors' fused.ply; single seed, paper's own default differs 0.2 dB between Tables 1 and 5.
issues.fix: Run >=2-3 seeds for the 8-scene average and report spread; compare gain (drop minus nodrop) rather than absolute PSNR.

issues.problem: Probe checks counts, thresholds, no size prune and reset steps but not the split geometry (N=2 samples from N(mu,Sigma), scale/1.6) -- delegated to gsplat.ops.split, which does match official densify_and_split (0.8*N).

gsplat rasterization, classic mode, black background, clamp(0,1) as official

compares r_t at t=1,2500,5000,10000 to the official formula and requires density to raise on a counter/step mismatch (does not check runtime steps==total_steps)
CUDA: rate 0.1 applied at t=5000, rgb differs from all-Gaussian render, dropped Gaussians get zero gradient, still visible in visibility radii
no-grad render equals independent plain gsplat render (1e-5) and schedule is not advanced

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: sampling with replacement vs shuffled stack
gsplat vs Inria rasterizer (alpha clamp, radii, near plane)
evaluation SSIM uses valid convolution (official: same padding)
dataset_check: fewview3-r8 matches official: sorted names, test idx%8==0, train = round(linspace(0,len-1,3)) of the rest (fern/flower test counts 3/5 as expected), PIL BICUBIC resize full-res to round(W/8) x round(H/8) = 504x378 saved losslessly as PNG, SIMPLE_RADIAL focal scaled, cx,cy centred as official, COLMAP triangulation+MVS on the 3 training views only; horns/fortress/room clouds reused from r4 (resolution independent).
settings_check: All match official train.py/arguments: 10000 its, L1 1.0 + 0.2(1-SSIM), black bg, clamp, densify 500<it<10000 every 100, tau 5e-4, percent_dense 0.01, prune <0.005 with no size pruning (size_threshold=None), opacity reset (min(o,0.01)) at 3000/6000/9000 with Adam moments zeroed, lrs 1.6e-4*extent->1.6e-6, 0.0025/0.0025/20/0.05/0.005/0.001, Adam eps 1e-15, camera-extent scene scale, 3-NN init scales, init opacity 0.1.
nodrop_assessment: Fair and protocol-matched: gamma=0 makes compensation() return ones (identical to nn.Dropout(p=0)), same renderer/density/loss/data/init. It is the official code with drop rate 0, not the paper's 19.22 3DGS row (those numbers are copied from FSGS/CoR-GS), so compare gains, not absolutes.
paper_results_check: Table 1 (3/6/9-view, 3DGS and Ours), Table 2, Table 3 and Table 5 values all match the LaTeX source; Table 1 vs Table 5 default (20.76 vs 20.56) inconsistency correctly recorded. Table 1 resolution note (-r 8) agrees with scripts/train_llff.sh.
summary: No critical or major issues. Equations 5-7, schedule, test-time behaviour, training settings, densification logic (including zero-gradient dropped Gaussians counted in the denominator), dataset construction and paper_results.json match the paper and official code. Remaining items are minor protocol differences, chiefly the runtime's valid-padding evaluation SSIM, with-replacement view sampling, gsplat-vs-Inria rasterizer details and single-seed variance.
